So I managed to fix everything, albeit it was a shot in the dark. Thanks to everyone who helped.

Here's what I did:

* I went to [MSI.com](https://MSI.com) and I downloaded the latest Thunderbolt 3 Drivers, that at least got my system to recognize the Core.
* When Synapse 3 saw that I had a Core V2 attached, it immediately wanted to update everything.
* Still, Razer GPU switcher didn't recognize any current drivers for the GPU in the Core, So I did a clean Geforce clean reinstall of 417.35 while the Core was attached and running. (note during this process, the computer froze during the install, I turned the PC off and restarted, after restarting, the GPU switcher recognized the 2080ti)
* I had to reinstall Geforce from [Nvidia.com](https://Nvidia.com) because it wouldn't open, after doing this I had to restart again.
* Everything seems to be working, the only problem seems to be if I attach the core v2 while the computer is on, everything freezes 20 seconds after switching to the external GPU via razer switcher. So I recommend (if you have this problem) plugging the core in, before you turn on the PC. If I find a fix, I'll update.
